New agents must first earn reputation inside a haven network where an atlas of verified histories maps each identity to past grading accuracy. Disputes are settled by randomly sampling a quorum only from this atlas; votes are weighted by bonded stake, and wrong or collusive grading slashes that stake. An attacker must therefore acquire many aged, reputable identities and bond real collateral before influencing outcomes, so each fake identity is expensive to build and risking slashing, making sybil attacks unprofitable like a lantern
